name: Necromancy Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Inflict Wounds; Ray of Enfeeblement; Vampiric Touch; Blight; Raise Dead. After a Necromancy spell cast with a slot, roll and spend up to two unused Hit Dice to regain their total plus the slot level in Hit Points.

benefits.name: School Benefit
benefits.summary: After a Necromancy spell cast with a slot, roll and spend up to two unused Hit Dice to regain their total plus the slot level in Hit Points.
benefits.text: After you cast a Necromancy spell with a spell slot, you can roll up to two of your unused Hit Dice, spending them, and regain Hit Points equal to their total plus the slot's level. In a fight it happens while you're missing Hit Points, unless you turn it Off in the class tab.
